text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Secular opposition Socialist Forces Front leader Seddik Debaili says his party supporters will take part in the referendum on amending the constitution on November 28 but they will cast a "No" vote.
- Security forces smash networks of car smugglers.
- Political parties are divided on the referendum to amend the constitution.
- A new attack against a passenger train linking Algiers to Oran.
- The government adopts a state budget for 1997.
- President Liamine Zeroual returns to Algiers after his trip to Bahrain, China, Vietnam and Qatar. The visits opened new prospects for cooperation.
